meta.name: monsoon_stilt_village
meta.prompt: A monsoon-season stilt village on a river delta in flood: houses on tall stilts above the brown water, boats moored to the verandas, a floating market at the confluence.

programs.brief: A sprawling floating market cluster of connected wooden rafts, canopied trade sampans, bamboo walkways, and produce stalls floating directly on the flooded confluence.

tokens.terrain: a braided river delta in heavy monsoon flood with a wide water confluence; brown floodwaters surrounding all dwelling foundations
tokens.icons: timber houses raised high on stilts above flood stage; longtail and dugout boats tied off to veranda posts; a floating market of laden trade boats at the main river confluence; connecting elevated plank walkways
